title: Grxnd Mxrquis releases a visual for new single "Ivan Ooze"
htmlContent:
Grxnd Mxrquis has released a music video for hs new single called "Ivan Ooze," an incredible music that showcases the true art and magic of music. The production takes you away to the dream world he creates for the listener, with the music having so much before you even hear the vocals. The message in the lyrics is everything we need more than ever, with it telling the listener to “Ivan Ooze”.
